meta.title: Find a Coach — The Switzerland Chapter of ICF
meta.description: Search the directory of ICF-credentialed coaches across Switzerland by region, language, credential level and specialisation.

hero.lede: Every coach listed holds an active ICF credential and commits to the ICF Code of Ethics.

credentials.title: ICF Credentials Explained
credentials.lede: Three credential levels show a coach's training, experience, and commitment to professional standards.

acc.title: Associate Certified Coach
acc.description: Min. 60 coaching hours + ICF-approved training. Entry-level credential.

pcc.title: Professional Certified Coach
pcc.description: Min. 500 coaching hours + demonstrated competency. Most common among Swiss coaches.

mcc.title: Master Certified Coach
mcc.description: Min. 2,500 coaching hours. Highest ICF credential level.

deib.title: Find a coach who understands your context
deib.lede: Our coaches come from diverse professional and personal backgrounds. Search for coaches with cultural competence, multilingual capability, or focus areas such as neurodiversity and inclusion.

organisations.title: Looking for multiple coaches?
organisations.lede: Contact us for bespoke introductions to coaches with organisational and team coaching expertise.

results.emptyBody: Try widening your canton or specialisation.
results.emptyModeBody: No results in {mode} match your filters yet — try widening your canton or specialisation.
results.errorBody: Please try again in a moment.

note.title: Profiles sourced from ICF Global
note.body: Coach records are maintained by ICF Global. Members can extend their profile with additional content on this portal.

inactive.title: The Coach Finder is not open yet
inactive.body: We are preparing the directory of ICF-credentialed coaches in Switzerland. It is currently switched off, so no coaches are listed. You can already see what a coach profile will look like, and we will announce the launch on this page.

demo.notice: This is a fictional example profile, shown while the Coach Finder is not yet open. Anna Muster is not a real coach and cannot be contacted.

detail.notFoundBody: The profile may have been unpublished. Browse the directory to find another credentialed coach.
